meta_title: Bristol Spray Finishing | Spray Painter Bristol
meta_description: Bristol Spray Finishing delivers expert spray painting and finishing for homes and businesses across Bristol. Fast, professional results. Call today.
hero_subhead: Flawless spray-painted finishes for doors, furniture, kitchens and commercial spaces across Bristol. Smooth, durable results in half the time.
services_subhead: From kitchen cabinet spraying to full interior refresh, we deliver professional spray-painted finishes that transform spaces.

services.title: Kitchen Cabinet Spraying
services.desc: Revitalise tired kitchens with bespoke spray-painted cabinet finishes. We achieve flawless, hard-wearing results without the disruption of traditional painting.

services.title: Door and Frame Spraying
services.desc: Perfectly smooth painted finishes on internal and external doors. Fast application, minimal mess, and a durable professional look.

services.title: Furniture Refinishing
services.desc: Give old wood and composite furniture new life with expert spray finishing. Ideal for dressers, wardrobes, tables and custom pieces.

services.title: Commercial Spray Painting
services.desc: Fast turnaround on shop fronts, office fit-outs and industrial surfaces. We work around your business hours to minimise downtime.

services.title: Exterior Wood Spraying
services.desc: Weather-resistant spray finishes for garden gates, fascias, soffits and exterior joinery. Long-lasting protection with a professional appearance.

services.title: Lacquer and Varnish Finishes
services.desc: Premium lacquered or varnished surfaces for a showroom-quality result. Ideal for bespoke joinery and high-end furniture pieces.

about_pullquote: We spray finish the way it should be done — no shortcuts, no compromise.
about_para_1: Bristol Spray Finishing was founded on the belief that spray application transforms how spaces look and feel. Over 12 years, we've developed a reputation for meticulous preparation and flawless finishes across Bristol and the surrounding areas. Our team of experienced spray painters have completed over 1000 kitchen, furniture and commercial projects, each one held to the same exacting standard.
about_para_2: We're known for getting it right first time. Homeowners and commercial clients trust us because we listen to what you want, use only high-quality materials, and take pride in every job — whether it's a single door or a full kitchen refresh. Our spray application cuts application time in half compared to traditional brushwork, getting your space back in use faster without compromising durability or finish quality.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had our kitchen doors sprayed and the finish is absolutely stunning. No drips, no brush marks — just a silky smooth, professional result. They were in and out in two days. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Catherine P.

reviews.text: Needed our garden gate and fascias resprayed before winter. The team arrived on time, protected everything properly, and the colour match was spot-on. Quality job at a fair price.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Used them for our office fit-out. Quick turnaround, professional crew, no fuss. They even worked early mornings so we weren't disrupted during the day. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Emma T.
